mainText: The U.S. military attacked three Iranian oil tankers after reporting that Navy ships were targeted with missiles.

titleText: JTF News: BBC News, PBS NewsHour
mainText: Rescuers in Nepal are attempting to reach dozens of people trapped in a tunnel after two were found alive.

titleText: JTF News: BBC News, CBC News
mainText: At least two people died in a blast at a Bolivia military barracks.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, BBC News
mainText: Russia conducted a drone attack on a Ukrainian security headquarters location, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky.
Steven Witkoff and Jared Kushner, envoys for President Trump, are scheduled to visit Russia and Ukraine in coming days.
